en.title: Cetu Soft Capsule
en.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine used for supplementation of vitamin E during old age, for relief of peripheral circulation disorders and menopausal shoulder/neck stiffness, numbness of hands and feet, and cold hands and feet, and for muscle cramps caused by magnesium deficiency.
en.usage:
Children aged 8 and older and adults: take 1 capsule twice daily.
Follow the prescribed dosage.
en.caution:
Do not take this medicine if any of the following applies: those hypersensitive to this medicine or to soybean oil, soybeans, or peanuts; infants under 12 months; or severe renal failure.

Consult a pharmacist before use if you are pregnant, may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding; cardiac/circulatory dysfunction; renal impairment; hypoproteinemia; a lipid-metabolism disorder such as hyperlipoproteinemia, diabetic hyperlipidemia, or pancreatitis, or otherwise require caution with lipid emulsions; hypersensitive to Yellow No. 5 or have such experience; at special risk from lipid overload; or a thrombotic (blood-vessel-blocking) predisposition.

Follow the prescribed dosage and usage.

When administering to children, do so under the guidance and supervision of a guardian.

Do not take with phosphates, calcium salts, oral tetracyclines, or antacids. Consult a pharmacist when using with estrogen-containing oral contraceptives, antialdosterone agents, triamterene, or intravenous lipid preparations. Avoid tannin-containing teas such as green tea and black tea during, before, and after taking this medicine.

If gastric discomfort, diarrhea, constipation, rash, redness (congested reddening), red spots, cardiac arrest, central nervous system depression, or menstruation coming earlier than expected, increasing in amount, or bleeding for a prolonged period occur, stop immediately and consult a pharmacist.
